description.zh: 两列相同的波迎面相遇叠加，波形不再前进、只在原地起伏：有的点始终不动（波节），有的点振幅最大（波腹）；两端固定的弦只允许 L = nλ/2 的波长，驱动频率对上其中之一就会共振。
description.en: Two identical waves meeting head-on add into a pattern that no longer travels and only rises and falls in place: some points never move (nodes) and others swing hardest (antinodes); a string fixed at both ends allows only wavelengths with L = nλ/2, and driving it at one of those frequencies makes it resonate.

zh: 为什么吉他弦只发出某些音
en: why does a guitar string sound only certain notes

reason.zh: 每一点的位移是右行波和左行波位移之和；A sin(ωt − kx) + A sin(ωt + kx) = 2A cos(kx) sin(ωt) 把空间和时间分开，波形就不再前进。
reason.en: Each point’s displacement is the sum of the right- and left-moving waves; A sin(ωt − kx) + A sin(ωt + kx) = 2A cos(kx) sin(ωt) separates space from time, so the pattern stops travelling.

label.zh: 驱动频率踩中模式就是共振
label.en: Driving on a mode is resonance

reason.zh: 固定的两端只放行 fₙ = n·f₁ 这一族固有频率；外力频率命中其中一个时，整根弦点亮成对应模式、振幅冲高——这就是共振在弦上的样子。
reason.en: Fixed ends admit only the family of natural frequencies fₙ = n·f₁; when the driving frequency hits one, the whole string lights up in that mode and the amplitude soars — resonance on a string.

label.zh: 同是叠加，静点来历不同

reason.zh: 干涉的静点来自两个波源到观测点的路程差，铺成空间里的条纹；驻波的波节来自一列波与反向同伴在一维上叠加，判定量只是位置 x。两者别混为一谈。
reason.en: Interference’s quiet points come from the path difference between two sources and spread into fringes in space; a standing wave’s nodes come from one wave meeting its reversed partner along a line, decided by position x alone. Keep the two apart.

question.zh: 为什么一根吉他弦只能发出某些音？
question.en: Why can a guitar string only sound certain notes?

ask.zh: 两端钉死时，哪些波长能在弦上稳定存在？
ask.en: With both ends fixed, which wavelengths can survive on the string?

ask.zh: 拨弦或驱动时，为什么只有对上固有频率的振动会变大？
ask.en: When plucked or driven, why do only vibrations at natural frequencies grow large?

reveal.zh: 两端固定要求两端始终是波节，所以只有 L = nλ/2 的波长能稳定存在，频率排成 f₁、2f₁、3f₁……的台阶。拨弦激起的正是这些模式，基频定音高，各次谐波的配比定音色。
reveal.en: Fixed ends must always be nodes, so only wavelengths with L = nλ/2 survive and the frequencies form steps f₁, 2f₁, 3f₁, … Plucking excites exactly these modes: the fundamental sets the pitch and the mix of harmonics sets the tone.
